title: A burial comparison

doesNotKnow: In the stipulated comparison the earlier-buried remains are covered sooner, while the other remains stay exposed at the surface. Burial can help preservation, but does not guarantee a fossil.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: In this toy comparison, two remains start alike. One stays exposed longer while one is buried sooner. Which is protected from surface scavengers sooner?
